'''Ren Terlo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Major/Legends|Major]] in the [[Cularin Militia]]. He commanded their forces during the [[Battle of Dorumaa]] and afterward, he met with Major [[Vayla Sevren]] of the [[Thaereian military]], to negotiate the base's surrender.
